```yaml
name: Claude GHA Workflow on Mention

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude-mention:
    if: contains(github.event.comment.body, '@Claude') || contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Log mention event
        run: |
          echo "Claude mentioned"
          echo "Author: ${{ github.event.comment.user.login }}"
          echo "URL: ${{ github.event.comment.html_url }}"
```
